content: Investigate INC-4917 and remediate it safely.

Root cause: release rel‑2031 lowered the DB pool maximumPoolSize from 50 to 10, causing connection exhaustion (HikariPool timeout) and a spike in latency and 5xx errors.  
Action: rolled back checkout‑api to the previous stable release rel‑2030.  
Verification: p95 latency has been below the 400 ms SLO for the last 3 minutes.
